description: Read or change the person's Hostlo preferences. Today that is the language of Hostlo's emails and web pages: English (en) or Khmer (km). Use it when they ask to read Hostlo in Khmer or English. Your own replies stay in whatever language you are speaking with them.

language.description:
The language for Hostlo's emails and pages: "en" (English) or "km" (Khmer). Leave out to
only read the current preferences.
